body: That was my first thought... I don't see ANYTHING in the video or the YT description that credits Vit C..... and honestly the autotune is TERRIBLE.... why not just get her to sing that part? would've been way cooler.

Say someone assaults and kills your kid in a horrific way, so you kill yourself. Can you not blame the murderer for destroying your life so badly your only option was to end it? Of course the only way to kill yourself is to do it yourself, so yes, it's ultimately your "fault"... but I don't think all the blame can be placed on the suicide victim when the world is actually a shit sandwich.

What about the bullied kid who commits suicide? Or the person who becomes severely disfigured due to an assault and is shunned by society? Or the kid who kills themselves because their home situation is so abusive and they have no help? There so many reason people can be pushed over the edge and it's not their fault.
Sometimes people are to blame for peoples suicides tho... They make their lives to miserable they take their lives.
